```python
import cyclopts


def greet(name: str, excited: bool = False):
    """Print a greeting.

    Parameters
    ----------
    name: str
        Name of the person to greet.
    excited: bool
        Whether to greet excitedly.
    """
    greeting = f"Hello, {name}!"
    if excited:
        greeting = greeting.upper()
    print(greeting)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    cyclopts.run(greet)
```
